Shipra Jain Contact Details: Homedecorliving1@gmail.com | (+91) 8376967710 / 8851274553 | Delhi-NCR Process Excellence & Digital Transformation Lead | Lean Six Sigma Black Belt

PROFILE SUMMARY

Process Excellence & Digital Transformation Lead with 13+ years of total experience, including 8+ years of expertise leading Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement & Process Governance Programs.

Proven track record across Banking, Mortgage Lending, Finance (AP) with extended experience in IT Process Re-engineering (EdTech, Logistics) and Digital Transformation.

Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt adept at driving end-to-end DMAIC initiatives, executing Value Stream Mapping (VSM), managing risk and mitigation frameworks (FMEA) and standardizing SOPs across operations — consistently translating process improvements into measurable ROI through FTE savings and cost efficiency.

Accomplished CI Coach with demonstrated success mentoring of CI agents, deploying Target Operating Models (TOM) and partnering with senior leadership to drive measurable efficiency, capacity and turnaround time gains.

Early hands-on experience governing Agentic AI workflows — designing exception-handling logic and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) controls for autonomous process automation.

Experienced in project management, ranging from driving self-initiated workflow transformations to leading dedicated 7-member operational excellence team. Skilled in delivering projects via Agile methodologies, structuring sprint deliverables, and supporting project owners to achieve strategic milestones.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Transformation & Leadership: Business & Digital Transformation, Stakeholder Management, Change Management, Agentic AI Governance, CI Coaching, Technical-Functional Bridging

Methodology & Risk Analysis: Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC, Root Cause Analysis (RCA / 5-Why / Fishbone Analysis), Pareto Analysis, Failure Mode & Effects Analysis (FMEA), Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Time & Motion study, Process Optimisation, Data Driven Insights

Operational Governance: Business Process Re-engineering (BPR), Target Operating Model (TOM), SOP Standardization, SLA/KPI architecture, VOC, SIPOC, BRD/FRD Creation, Project Charter, GCC, Agile Delivery Frameworks

Process Intelligence & Tools: BPMN 2.0 Process Mapping (SAP Signavio/Visio), Process Mining (SAP Signavio, Celonis-trained), JIRA, Confluence, Power BI, Advanced Excel

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

IRIS Software | Lead – Optimisation Consultant Managed transformation, process re-engineering and automation frameworks

(Apr 2024–May 2026)

Governed the Process Architecture for DaaS and Agentic AI initiatives, architected BPMN 2.0 decision-logic in MS Visio to transition manual workflows into autonomous execution for 20+ enterprise programs.

Acted as the final validation checkpoint before go-live - after aligning with Architecture, Dev, and QA on process and technical readiness, I secured sign-off from the project owner to confirm each workflow was compliant and ready for publishing. • Managed the Centralized Process Repository in Confluence, documented end-to-end DaaS workflows, Business Glossary

adopted by all teams as standardized source of truth and Agentic AI Guardrails.

Executed requirement gathering and business analysis leveraging VOC, BRD documentation through brainstorming sessions, targeted requirements workshops and operational observations.

Defined 'Condition-Based Branching' and HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) logic for Agentic AI invoice automation, partnering with the tech team to implement it and eliminate manual data entry while maintaining a full JIRA-tracked audit trail.

Applied Lean principles to streamline legacy operational processes prior to cloud and digital transitions, eliminating redundant human touchpoints and non-value-added steps.

Maintained project plans and tracked milestones, risks, and dependencies across workstreams, providing regular, accurate status reporting to stakeholders.

Key Projects (IRIS): Project 1: Agentic AI & Logistics Automation (Logistics Operations) Objective: Eliminate manual data entry in logistics invoice processing by deploying autonomous AI agents with exception handling. Transformation: Defined the Agentic AI Logic Framework in BPMN 2.0; engineered Condition-Based Branching where the AI agent simultaneously triggers real-time Email alerts to the onshore team and logs JIRA tickets for exception. Impact: Achieved a 30% reduction in manual processing effort while maintaining a full audit trail of every exception in JIRA, ensuring every Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) intervention was tracked, assigned, and resolved with full visibility.

Project 2: Strategic Cloud Migration & DaaS Architecture (EdTech IT Operations) Objective: Redesign 20+ legacy Edtech programs ahead of cloud migration.

Transformation: Led the Process Governance and gap analysis to identify and eliminate process bottlenecks and non-value steps by technical mapping of data flows; used BPMN 2.0. Impact: Optimized the “To-Be” state to achieve a 20% reduction in cycle time for program onboarding and established standardized, audit-ready operational workflows for the DaaS team.

HSBC ELECTRONIC DATA PROCESSING | Manager – OTPE Led Global Process Standardization across GSC operations and served as Continuous Improvement Coach

(Jun 2022–Jan 2024)



Led Global Process Architecture by designing "Golden/Master Maps" for 26 countries in SAP Signavio; enforced BPMN 2.0 standards to drive process standardization and eliminate global SLA variances (24hr vs. 48hr).

Conducted advanced “What-If” analysis via Signavio to optimize FTE requirements for Wholesale Credit operations, resulting in a 5% reduction in resource overhead across 11 international markets, which adopted an accreditation-based QA model and RPA-driven reporting. Facilitated deep-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Fishbone diagrams, Pareto Analysis, FMEA and SIPOC/VOC-driven scoping with Global Process Owners to translate operational risk vulnerabilities into high-ROI workflow automation and structured improvement roadmaps.



Built Real-Time Governance Dashboards to provide executive stakeholders with transparent visibility into project milestones, deployment metrics, and active risk mitigation portfolios.

Ensured process documentation and control artifacts met audit-readiness standards as part of process responsibilities. • Served as a Continuous Improvement (CI) Coach, mentored CI agents and managed multiple high-impact DMAIC projects focused on error-reduction and efficiency gains in Wholesale Lending workflows.

Key Projects (HSBC): Project 1: Global Process Architecture & Standardization (26 Markets) Objective: Eliminate process fragmentation across 26 onshore and offshore markets by establishing a unified Target Operating Model. Transformation: Architected end-to-end Value Stream Mapping of Wholesale Credit services using SAP Signavio; enforced strict BPMN 2.0 standards to establish a "Golden/Master Map" for global operations. Impact: Achieved 20% faster process adoption, with 11 markets adopting the accreditation model and RPA-driven reporting as the new standard.

Project 2: Rework Reduction in Credit Operations (6 Markets) Objective: Reduce high rework volume caused by manual rate-calculation errors (Fixed Rate + Spread) at disbursement across 6 markets. Transformation: Diagnosed Root Cause using RCA and Pareto analysis; implemented an Excel-based calculation template with auto-fetched spread data and manual fixed-rate entry, with template upload to loan package as a QA control point. Impact: Reduced manual calculation errors by 20%, accelerated turnaround time (TAT) for Wholesale Lending disbursements.

BETTER.COM | Ops. Team Leader – Title & Settlement Managed high-performance execution teams focused on operational quality of US Mortgage

(Jan 2020–May 2022)

Governed the Operational Excellence framework for a team of 18+, enforcing strict SLA compliance, quality standards, and turnaround-time (TAT) metrics within US Mortgage operations.

Drove Continuous Improvement initiatives through Time & Motion studies and Gap Analysis, collaborating with cross-functional squads to integrate streamlined updates into SOPs and remove processing friction from mortgage documentation lifecycle. Led Data-Driven Performance Monitoring by building real-time dashboards to identify and resolve bottlenecks, maintaining end- to-end visibility and revised KPIs.



Key Project: Operational Transition & Workflow Standardization (US Mortgage): Objective: Managed the process transition and standardization of Title & Settlement workflows during a high-volume growth phase. Transformation: Executed a Time and Motion study alongside GAP analysis to baseline task durations, eliminated non-value-added processing friction, and anchored the Control phase to integrate streamlined updates into SOPs and revised team KPIs. Impact: Established a unified operational model that achieved 30% time efficiency and saved 4 FTEs, reducing operational cost.

GENPACT INDIA PVT LTD. | SME & Workflow Coordinator Progressive experience across Banking & Finance (AP) domains

(Jun 2012–Dec 2019)

Coordinated Workflow and Quality Assurance for the Commercial and Housing Loan teams of a leading Australian Bank,



ensuring adherence to risk and regulatory frameworks. Identified and mitigated operational gaps by auditing the end-to-end loan disbursement lifecycle — leveraging Lean methodologies and RPA concepts to optimize process cycle times, resolve client documentation discrepancies, and deliver data-driven improvements across high-volume workstreams.

Collaborated with the Automation team to transition manual F&A tasks to system-driven logic, assisting in the development of Oracle templates for recurring journal entries and invoice processing.

Key Projects (Banking): •

Lending Cycle Optimization: Diagnosed process bottlenecks using Value Stream Mapping, Kanban, 5-Why, RCA to eliminate documentation delays; achieved 20% time efficiency and 3 FTE savings.

•

Total Lending Approval Accreditation: Identified Approval Dependency as the primary root cause for SLA breaches. Secured TLAA delegated authority, eliminating approval-dependency delays and improving TAT by 20%.

Masters (PGDM) in Operations – IMT Ghaziabad • AI-Enabled Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certified – June2026 • PMI - Generative AI for Project Managers • Banking Demystified Certified
